info.name: Retrieve paginated conversation insights records based on date range as input

params.name: timeframeFrom
params.description: Starting time frame value ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:SS') for filtering conversation records on the processing timestamp by Cuein

params.name: timeframeTo
params.description: Ending time frame value ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:SS') for filtering conversation records on the processing timestamp by Cuein

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token to use for next batch lookup (empty returns the first batch of records)

params.description: Limit of results to return (default system limits exist)
